title: Dual JSON+MD exec-plans (machine workboard) + status-first routing gate

slices.description: Templates document the dual-file rule + JSON schema + Session Context Handoff; demo-auth gets a JSON twin
steps: full-plan.md gains the Session Context Handoff section and the twin-file rule note
quick-plan.md gains the same handoff section and points at the schema
JSON schema documented once in full-plan.md (fields: plan_id, title, status, current_slice_id, slices[].id/category/description/steps/passes)
docs/examples/demo-auth/0001-demo-auth.json created as the worked example
bash tests/run.sh stays green

slices.description: harness.sh status prints the workboard from JSON twins; doctor warns on missing/unparseable twins
steps: status lists per-plan JSON status + current slice + next passes:false slice (awk only, no jq)
parsing tolerates arbitrary indentation and blank lines in the twin
plans without a JSON twin keep the current MD-only output (no breakage)
doctor emits warn (not fail) for missing or unparseable twin
tests/run.sh covers: parse fixture, missing twin fallback, doctor warning

slices.description: init.sh routing-gate v2: HARNESS_ROUTING_GATE markers, CRITICAL text, migration of the old gate block
steps: CLAUDE.md gate block rewritten with HARNESS_ROUTING_GATE_BEGIN/END markers and the CRITICAL AGENT INSTRUCTION text
re-run on an install with the old harness-mini:start/end block replaces it (exactly one gate remains)
re-run on an install with the new block is a no-op (idempotent)
.cursor rule wording aligned to status-first
tests/run.sh covers: fresh inject, idempotent re-run, old-marker migration

slices.description: AGENTS.md single merged routing gate, status-first, with Repository Map additions
steps: gate section instructs: on a new session MUST run bin/harness.sh status first
Repository Map lines added: active plans in docs/exec-plans/active/ (never load full history), 40% guardrail pointer
exactly one routing-gate section remains in AGENTS.md
old version-first fresh-session line removed from the gate

slices.description: Skills state the dual-file contract end to end
steps: to-issues: emit the JSON twin beside every MD plan it creates
checkpoint: refresh the plan's Session Context Handoff section
stage-viewer: advancing updates JSON status/current_slice_id; only main flips passes
evaluate: passes flips to true only after an evaluator verdict (anti-self-praise)
skills stay under ~90 lines each, map-not-encyclopedia tone

slices.description: CHANGELOG Unreleased entry + walkthrough/README consistency sweep + full green run
steps: CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry describing the dual-file contract and gate v2
docs/walkthrough.md consistent with the new plan format
bash tests/run.sh fully green
grep sweep: no stale references to the old gate wording remain
